name: Beforepay
summary: Pay On Demand for working Australians — migrated from two native apps to Flutter.
overview: Beforepay’s Pay On Demand lets working Australians access part of their wages before payday for a fixed 5% fee. Two native codebases meant every feature was built twice — and the apps drifted.
owned: Designed the native‑to‑Flutter migration strategy across iOS and Android
Wrote the Flutter vs Kotlin Multiplatform RFC that set the long‑term platform direction
Built Method Channel bridges so legacy modules kept running during migration
keyDecision: Migrate incrementally behind bridges instead of a rewrite — the app moves money, so releases could never stop.

name: Rent Collector
summary: Helps landlords track tenants, rooms, meters and exactly who hasn’t paid for which month.
overview: Rent Collector (ভাড়া আদায়) helps Bangladeshi landlords manage rooms, tenants, meters and electricity bills — and see exactly who hasn’t paid, for which month.
owned: Run the product end to end as founder: requirement and feature analysis through to finalised tickets
Build and ship both the Android app and the web app
Handle customer support myself, and feed what landlords ask for back into the roadmap
keyDecision: Bangla‑first UI and mobile‑number sign‑in, because that’s how landlords in Bangladesh actually work.
